#ui/widgets

Xu {{xu_version}} API

import: #ui/widgets

counts: 104 函数, 1632 方法, 89 类型, 156 常量, 4 方法集

Button、Checkbox、Progress、Scroll、Input / TextArea 与保留 View。Styles 提供字体、密度、颜色、几何和组合状态规则；StyledLabel 缓存排版。局部主题是完整快照。set_style_measure 注册测量，文字变化后 mark_measure；layout_styled 后 place_editor，再 present_styled。样式回调借用主题，使用节点局部坐标，不能修改 View 或拓扑。

使用指南与生命周期

扩展控件与统一样式切换

Switch、Radio、Slider、Stepper、Tabs、Select、Badge、Divider、Card 与 ListBox 共享 Styles、组合状态绘制规则、阴影及图标位置。使用 widgets.style_switcher() 创建深色、浅色和高对比预设；调用 use_preset、set_text_scale、set_density 后，通过 apply 应用到保留 View，或用 cycle 切换并应用下一预设。这些方法可能失败，须处理错误。View 接收完整样式快照，控件的显式覆盖继续生效。

正式版示例（完整工程与源码下载）：widgets · editor_workbench · style_gallery · controls_gallery

将统一样式应用到保留 View：

@main
#ui/widgets

fn configure(view $&widgets.View) int {
    $themes := widgets.style_switcher()
    themes.use_preset(widgets.THEME_LIGHT) or >>
    themes.set_text_scale(1.2) or >>
    themes.set_density(0.85) or >>
    themes.apply(view) or >>
    // Call this from a theme-switch action to advance and apply the preset.
    themes.cycle(view) or >>
    << 0
}
fn main() int { << 0 }

组件工作坊：图文按钮、Tooltip 与密码

component_workshop 完整工程与源码提供 46 个入口，可切换主题、密度、100%/140%/200% 字号以及禁用、只读和错误状态。需要与源码配套的 Xu 0.10.11；Windows/Linux 的交叉构建不等于目标机器 GUI 验收。

Screen.button_with_icon() 创建图文按钮，icon_button() 创建纯图标按钮。每个按钮保存自己的样式快照；分别设置 icon_size 和 ICON_LEADING/TRAILING/ABOVE/BELOW，再用 measure_button() 获取内容尺寸并放置，避免示例按钮占满整行。资源随 --www 嵌入，下面的代码需要 www/logo.png。

Tooltip 默认上方居中；set_tooltip_placement() 设置四方向和边缘翻转。普通悬停约 500 ms 显示，键盘或显式焦点立即显示；移出、点击或滚动时收起。Escape 抑制当前这一轮提示，离开重入或重新聚焦后恢复。完全滚出裁剪区域的锚点不显示提示。

password_input() 是单行 Input 的真实密码模式，每个 Unicode 字素对应一个圆点。set_password_visible() 显隐切换保留值和选择；支持粘贴，显文时也禁止复制和剪切。原生周围文字查询和 XACP 节点文本不返回密码；text_value() 仍为应用返回实际值。应用应自行管理值的保存和日志，不应将掩码误认为内存加密。

@main
#ui/widgets

fn configure(screen $&widgets.Screen, styles &widgets.Styles) int {
    button := screen.button_with_icon("logo.png", "Build project") or >>
    $appearance := styles.button_variant(widgets.BUTTON_PRIMARY) or >>
    appearance.icon_placement = widgets.ICON_ABOVE
    appearance.icon_size = 32.0 * styles.text_scale
    screen.set_control_style(button, &appearance) or >>
    size := screen.measure_button(button) or >>
    screen.place(button, 24.0, 24.0, size.width, size.height) or >>
    tip := screen.tooltip(button, "Build project") or >>
    $placement := widgets.overlay_placement()
    placement.side = widgets.OVERLAY_RIGHT
    placement.align = widgets.OVERLAY_CENTER
    screen.set_tooltip_placement(tip, &placement) or >>
    password := screen.password_input("") or >>
    screen.place(password, 24.0, 160.0, 320.0, 48.0) or >>
    << 0
}
fn main() int { << 0 }

@main
#ui
#ui/widgets
#ui/webview
#math
demo #"github.com/xulang-org/examples/ui_demo"

fn document(title string,tone string) string {
    << "<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><title>" + title + "</title><style>body{margin:0;padding:28px;font:15px -apple-system,system-ui;color:#252521;background:#faf9f6}small{letter-spacing:.14em;color:#797970}h1{font-size:28px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:16px 0}p{line-height:1.65;color:#6b6b63}input,button{box-sizing:border-box;font:inherit;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;width:100%;margin:8px 0}input{border:1px solid #d8d8cf;background:white;outline-color:" + tone + "}button{border:0;background:" + tone + ";color:white;cursor:pointer}output{display:block;min-height:42px;padding:12px 0;line-height:1.5;color:" + tone + "}</style></head><body><small>EMBEDDED WEBVIEW</small><h1>" + title + "</h1><p>This document has its own viewport, focus and request identity.</p><input aria-label='Message' value='Hello from " + title + "'><button onclick='send()'>Ask native Xu</button><output aria-live='polite'>Ready for an independent native request.</output><p>Tab moves inside this document.<br>Ctrl + Tab returns to the native controls.</p><script>async function send(){let out=document.querySelector('output');out.textContent='Waiting…';try{out.textContent=await window.__XU__.invoke('echo',document.querySelector('input').value)}catch(e){out.textContent=e.message}}</script></body></html>"
}
fn route(request webview.InvokeRequest) string {
    target := request.target() or (err) { << "Target closed: " + err.msg() }
    script := "document.title"
    options := ui.RequestOptions{timeout_ms: 3000}
    result := ui.webview_request_wait(&target,ui.REQUEST_WEBVIEW_EVAL,&script,&options) or (err) { << err.msg() }
    << result.value + " · " + request.payload + " · view " + str(target.canvas_id)
}
fn ipc(events chan ui.Event,emits chan string) {
    webview.bind_ipc_requests_www(":mem:",route,emits,events) or (err) { eprintln(err.msg())
        << }
}
fn scene(events chan ui.Event) int {
    ready := demo.ready(events) or >>
    if ready.kind == ui.EV_EXIT { << 0 }
    $screen := widgets.screen(&ready) or >>
    screen.resize(1020.0,720.0) or >>
    screen.set_min_size(760,580) or >>
    title := screen.label("Web content. Native composition.",26.0,false) or >>
    subtitle := screen.label("Two independent WebViews inside a Canvas window",13.0,true) or >>
    hide := screen.button("Hide left") or >>
    reload := screen.button("Reload right") or >>
    close := screen.button("Dispose left") or >>
    modal_button := screen.button("Open modal") or >>
    left := screen.webview() or >>
    right := screen.webview() or >>
    status := screen.label("Resize the window, edit both pages, or test their native requests.",13.0,true) or >>
    modal := screen.modal("Native overlay","The WebViews resume when this dialog closes.") or >>
    dismiss := screen.button("Close dialog") or >>
    screen.set_parent(dismiss,modal) or >>
    screen.place(dismiss,24.0,175.0,180.0,38.0) or >>
    screen.load_web_html(left,document("Editor preview","#b64c3c")) or >>
    screen.load_web_html(right,document("Reference panel","#386f6b")) or >>
    $hidden := false
    $disposed := false
    while screen.is_open() {
        width := screen.width()
        height := screen.height()
        half := (width - 76.0) * 0.5
        screen.place(title,28.0,25.0,width-56.0,38.0) or >>
        screen.place(subtitle,28.0,69.0,width-56.0,25.0) or >>
        screen.place(hide,28.0,112.0,136.0,38.0) or >>
        screen.place(reload,174.0,112.0,146.0,38.0) or >>
        screen.place(close,330.0,112.0,136.0,38.0) or >>
        screen.place(modal_button,476.0,112.0,136.0,38.0) or >>
        screen.place(left,28.0,174.0,half,math.max(300.0,height-245.0)) or >>
        screen.place(right,48.0+half,174.0,half,math.max(300.0,height-245.0)) or >>
        screen.place(status,28.0,height-49.0,width-56.0,28.0) or >>
        _ := screen.render() or >>
        for action in screen.next(events) or >> {
            if action.kind == widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE {
                if action.id == hide && !disposed { hidden = !hidden
                    screen.set_visible(left,!hidden) or >>
                    if hidden { screen.set_text(hide,"Show left") or >> } else { screen.set_text(hide,"Hide left") or >> } }
                if action.id == reload { screen.webview_command(right,"reload") or >> }
                if action.id == close && !disposed { screen.close_webview(left) or >>
                    disposed = true
                    screen.set_enabled(hide,false) or >>
                    screen.set_enabled(close,false) or >> }
                if action.id == modal_button { screen.open(modal) or >> }
                if action.id == dismiss { screen.close_overlay(modal) or >> }
            }
            if action.kind == widgets.ACTION_WEB_LOADED { screen.set_text(status,"WebView " + str(action.id) + " loaded independently") or >> }
            if action.kind == widgets.ACTION_WEB_FAILED { screen.set_text(status,"WebView " + str(action.id) + " failed to load") or >> }
        }
    }
    screen.dispose()
    << 0
}
fn worker(events chan ui.Event) { scene(events) or (err) { demo.fail(err.msg())
    << } }
fn launch() int {
    $app := demo.app("XUUI / WebView Components",1020,720) or >>
    _ := ui.register_content_plugin(ui.content_plugin_webview())
    emits := chan string{cap: 64}
    xu ipc(app.event_ch,emits)
    xu worker(app.event_ch)
    << app.run() or >>
}
fn main() int { << launch() or (err) { eprintln(err.msg())
    << 1 } }

@main

#ui
#ui/widgets
#xacp
#errors

demo #"github.com/xulang-org/examples/ui_demo"

struct Model {
    label_id int
    count int
}

fn (m $&Model) layout(s $&widgets.Screen) int {
    s.place(m.label_id,32.0,36.0,540.0,44.0) or >>
    << 0
}

fn (m $&Model) update(s $&widgets.Screen,action widgets.Action) int {
    if action.kind == widgets.ACTION_KEY && int(action.value) == ui.KEY_ESCAPE {
        s.close() or >>
    }
    if action.kind == widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE {
        m.count += 1
        s.set_text(m.label_id,"Button actions: " + str(m.count)) or >>
    }
    << 0
}

fn inspect_screen(s $&widgets.Screen) int {
    $session := xacp.open_session()
    permissions := xacp.PERM_UI_READ | xacp.PERM_UI_MUTATE
    if !xacp.set_permissions($&session,permissions) {
        xacp.close_session($&session)
        >> errors.new("xacp_screen: failed to set least-privilege UI permissions")
    }
    limits := xacp.default_limits()
    nodes := xacp.ui_tree($&*s,$&session,1,false,32,&limits) or (err) {
        xacp.close_session($&session)
        >> err
    }
    println("XACP ui.tree: " + str(nodes.len) + " visible nodes")
    for node in nodes {
        println("  #" + str(node.id) + " kind=" + str(node.kind) + " " + node.text)
    }

    $snapshot := xacp.ui_screenshot($&*s,$&session,2,1.0,&limits) or (err) {
        xacp.close_session($&session)
        >> err
    }
    println("XACP ui.screenshot: " + str(snapshot.pixel_width) + "x" + str(snapshot.pixel_height) + " pixels")
    snapshot.dispose() or (err) {
        xacp.close_session($&session)
        >> err
    }

    _ := xacp.ui_act($&*s,$&session,2,3,"focus","",false,&limits) or (err) {
        xacp.close_session($&session)
        >> err
    }
    xacp.close_session($&session)
    << 0
}

fn scene(events chan ui.Event) int {
    ready := demo.ready(events) or >>
    if ready.kind == ui.EV_EXIT { << 0 }
    $screen := widgets.screen(&ready) or >>
    screen.resize(640.0,180.0) or >>
    label_id := screen.label("XACP Screen adapter",22.0,false) or >>
    button_id := screen.button("Activate locally or through ui.act") or >>
    screen.place(label_id,32.0,36.0,540.0,44.0) or >>
    screen.place(button_id,32.0,96.0,360.0,40.0) or >>
    inspect_screen($&screen) or (err) {
        screen.dispose()
        >> err
    }
    $model := Model{label_id: label_id,count: 0}
    << widgets.run_screen($&screen,events,$&model) or >>
}

fn worker(events chan ui.Event) {
    scene(events) or (err) { demo.fail(err.msg())
        << }
}

fn launch() int {
    $app := demo.app("Xu / XACP Screen adapter",640,180) or >>
    xu worker(app.event_ch)
    << app.run() or >>
}

fn main() int {
    << launch() or (err) { eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1 }
}

Xu本地 SDK 示例
@main
#ui
#ui/draw
#ui/layout
#ui/widgets
demo #"github.com/xulang-org/examples/ui_demo"

fn rect(x f64,y f64,width f64,height f64) layout.Rect {
    << layout.Rect{x: x,y: y,width: width,height: height}
}

// One worker owns the controls and their canvas resources. Every recorded
// label remains alive until the complete frame has been accepted.
fn scene(ech chan ui.Event) int {
    ready := demo.ready(ech) or >>
    if ready.kind == ui.EV_EXIT { << 0 }
    identity := ui.canvas_of(&ready) or >>
    context := draw.context_of(&ready) or >>
    $switcher := widgets.style_switcher()
    switcher.use_preset(widgets.THEME_LIGHT) or >>
    $toggle := widgets.switch_control(&identity,1,&rect(48.0,116.0,280.0,48.0),true) or >>
    $radio := widgets.radio(&identity,2,&rect(48.0,180.0,280.0,48.0),1,false) or >>
    $slider := widgets.slider(&identity,3,&rect(48.0,260.0,280.0,36.0),0.0,100.0,50.0) or >>
    slider.set_step(5.0) or >>
    $stepper := widgets.stepper(&identity,4,&rect(48.0,324.0,280.0,48.0),0.0,20.0,1.0,5.0) or >>
    $tabs := widgets.tabs(&identity,5,&rect(376.0,116.0,348.0,48.0),3,0) or >>
    $dropdown := widgets.select_box(&identity,6,&rect(376.0,196.0,348.0,48.0),3,0) or >>
    $list := widgets.list_box(&identity,7,&rect(376.0,284.0,348.0,132.0),3,0) or >>
    panel := widgets.card(&rect(24.0,92.0,724.0,352.0)) or >>
    badge := widgets.badge(&rect(48.0,392.0,280.0,32.0)) or >>
    divider := widgets.divider(&rect(48.0,244.0,280.0,2.0),widgets.AXIS_HORIZONTAL) or >>
    $label0 := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Enabled")
    $label1 := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Choose this option")
    $label2 := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Stepper")
    $label3 := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"One")
    $label4 := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Two")
    $label5 := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Three")
    $label6 := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Select an option")
    $label7 := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Xu 0.10.2")
    $label8 := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"One")
    $label9 := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Two")
    $label10 := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Three")
    $frame := context.new_frame(16384)
    $dirty := true
    $focus := 0
    while true {
        if dirty {
            styles := switcher.styles()
            frame.begin() or >>
            frame.set_bg(styles.background) or >>
            panel.paint_styled($&frame,&styles) or >>
            ink := styles.button.palette.foreground
            title := "Extended controls / " + switcher.name()
            frame.text(32.0,28.0,22.0,ink,&title) or >>
            toggle.paint_styled($&frame,$&label0,&styles) or >>
            radio.paint_styled($&frame,$&label1,&styles) or >>
            divider.paint_styled($&frame,&styles) or >>
            slider.paint_styled($&frame,&styles) or >>
            stepper.paint_styled($&frame,$&label2,&styles) or >>
            tabs.paint_box_styled($&frame,&styles) or >>
            list.paint_box_styled($&frame,&styles) or >>
            tabs.paint_tab_styled($&frame,0,$&label3,&styles) or >>
            list.paint_item_styled($&frame,0,$&label8,&styles) or >>
            tabs.paint_tab_styled($&frame,1,$&label4,&styles) or >>
            list.paint_item_styled($&frame,1,$&label9,&styles) or >>
            tabs.paint_tab_styled($&frame,2,$&label5,&styles) or >>
            list.paint_item_styled($&frame,2,$&label10,&styles) or >>
            dropdown.paint_styled($&frame,$&label6,&styles) or >>
            badge.paint_styled($&frame,$&label7,&styles) or >>
            frame.text(32.0,464.0,15.0,ink,&"T: theme / S: text size / D: density / Tab: focus / Esc: quit") or >>
            status := "Slider " + str(int(slider.value())) + " / Stepper " + str(int(stepper.value())) + " / Select " + str(dropdown.selected() + 1)
            frame.text(32.0,494.0,15.0,ink,&status) or >>
            // A Select popup overlays the scene; this basic painter repeats
            // its label. The selected option index is shown in the status.
            dropdown.paint_popup_styled($&frame,$&label6,&styles) or >>
            frame.present() or >>
            toggle.painted()
            radio.painted()
            slider.painted()
            stepper.painted()
            tabs.painted()
            dropdown.painted()
            list.painted()
            dirty = false
        }
        event := demo.next(ech)
        if event.kind == ui.EV_EXIT { <- }
        if event.window_id != identity.window_id { -> }
        if event.kind == ui.EV_CANVAS_CLOSED { <- }
        if event.kind == ui.EV_CANVAS_METRICS { dirty = true }
        if ui.is_input_event(event.kind) {
            input := ui.input_of(&event) or >>
            if input.generation != identity.generation { -> }
            if input.kind == ui.EV_KEY_DOWN && input.repeat == 0 {
                if input.key == ui.KEY_ESCAPE {
                    // App shutdown revokes canvas resources. Do not enqueue
                    // another frame while the native host is closing.
                    demo.quit() or >>
                    << 0
                }
                if input.key == 84 || input.key == 116 { switcher.next() or >>
                    dirty = true }
                if input.key == 83 || input.key == 115 {
                    $scale := 1.4
                    if switcher.text_scale() > 1.0 { scale = 1.0 }
                    switcher.set_text_scale(scale) or >>
                    dirty = true
                }
                if input.key == 68 || input.key == 100 {
                    $density := 0.85
                    if switcher.density() < 1.0 { density = 1.0 }
                    switcher.set_density(density) or >>
                    dirty = true
                }
                if input.key == ui.KEY_TAB { focus = focus % 7 + 1
                    dirty = true }
            }
        }
        // Route the popup first. A modal option click must not also focus
        // or activate the ListBox underneath it.
        popup_open := dropdown.is_open()
        first := dropdown.event(&event) or >>
        $actions := [first]
        if !popup_open && !first.consumed {
            actions.push(toggle.event(&event) or >>)
            actions.push(radio.event(&event) or >>)
            actions.push(slider.event(&event) or >>)
            actions.push(stepper.event(&event) or >>)
            actions.push(tabs.event(&event) or >>)
            actions.push(list.event(&event) or >>)
        }
        for action in actions {
            if action.request_focus { focus = action.id }
            if action.needs_paint { dirty = true }
        }
        toggle.set_focus(focus == 1)
        radio.set_focus(focus == 2)
        slider.set_focus(focus == 3)
        stepper.set_focus(focus == 4)
        tabs.set_focus(focus == 5)
        dropdown.set_focus(focus == 6)
        list.set_focus(focus == 7)
    }
    frame.dispose()
    if demo.alive(&identity) {
        label0.dispose()
        label1.dispose()
        label2.dispose()
        label3.dispose()
        label4.dispose()
        label5.dispose()
        label6.dispose()
        label7.dispose()
        label8.dispose()
        label9.dispose()
        label10.dispose()
    }
    << 0
}
fn worker(ech chan ui.Event) {
    scene(ech) or (err) { demo.fail(err.msg())
        << }
}
fn launch() int {
    $app := demo.app("Xu UI / Extended Controls",780,552) or >>
    xu worker(app.event_ch)
    << app.run() or >>
}
fn main() int {
    << launch() or (err) { eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1 }
}

内容内边距，随 density 缩放
radius f64

focus_width f64
焦点环宽度；0 隐藏
focus_inset f64
焦点环内缩
min_width f64
最小逻辑宽度
min_height f64
最小逻辑高度；Scroll 中作为最小滑块长度
gap f64
文字、图标或指示器间距
indicator_size f64
Checkbox 指示器尺寸或 Scroll 条宽
mark_width f64
Checkbox 标记线宽
caret_width f64
编辑器光标宽度
preedit_width f64
预编辑下划线宽度
shadow_x f64
阴影水平偏移
shadow_y f64
阴影垂直偏移
shadow_spread f64
阴影扩展半径
shadow_blur f64
至多八层近似的阴影模糊半径
align_x f64
水平对齐，0–1
align_y f64
垂直对齐，0–1
icon_size f64
图片图标方形边长；0 不留图标间距
icon_placement int
icon_leading / trailing / above / below
icon_opacity f64
图标透明度，0–1
disabled_icon_opacity f64
禁用时再乘此透明度，0–1
shadow draw.Color
阴影颜色；透明表示无阴影
states []StatePaint
最多 32 条规则；后匹配的字段覆盖先匹配值
